about_the_game:
Disassemble. Strategize. Master each puzzle.
Unpuzzle Quest is a calm yet mentally engaging puzzle adventure where your goal is simple: disassemble intricate tile arrangements, piece by piece, until the board is cleared. With intuitive touch or drag mechanics, elegant design, and a series of 45 handcrafted levels, it’s a game that invites you to think, relax, and play at your own pace. Steam Store

Features

  • 45 unique, handcrafted levels that grow in complexity Steam Store

  • Simple but expressive touch / drag controls and intuitive interface Steam Store

  • Minimalist visuals and clean UI that put the puzzle front and center Steam Store

  • Calm, no-pressure gameplay—no timers, no forced speed Steam Store

  • Balanced mix of strategy and logic: every move counts Steam Store

  • Relaxing yet stimulating—ideal for short breaks or longer puzzle sessions

  • A singleplayer experience built for puzzle lovers and casual players alike

About This Game

Unpuzzle Quest invites you into a world of careful disassembly. Each level starts with a complex grouping of tiles. Your job is to move them—selecting or dragging—to break apart the configuration until no tiles remain. It sounds simple, but as layouts become more tangled, your planning and precision become crucial. Steam Store

At first, levels let you get comfortable: fewer tiles, clear paths, and forgiving layouts. But as you progress, obstacles, tighter placements, and more intertwined structures demand deeper strategy. You’ll need to anticipate how moving one tile affects the others, decide which tile to shift first, and calculate the chain reactions that lead to full disassembly.

Because there’s no timer or countdown, you can move at your own rhythm. Pause, reconsider, undo, retry—each level is yours to solve patiently. This relaxed approach helps you focus deeply, not panic under pressure.

The visual style is intentionally minimal. There are no distractions—just the tiles, the shapes, and the space between them. That clarity helps your mind parse complex layouts and keep track of possibilities. The interface pulls away, so your focus remains on logic and pattern rather than flashy effects.

Levels are replayable. Even after clearing a puzzle, you can revisit it to test new strategies, improve your move count, or simply enjoy unraveling it again. Each layout tends to feel fresh on replay because your approach changes.

Unpuzzle Quest sits at the intersection of casual design and thoughtful puzzle work. If you enjoy disassembly puzzles, spatial logic, or games where every move matters, this is one to dive into.
